children: Adicet Bio posted a September 2026 investor presentation highlighting prula-cel clinical progress and IND-cleared ADI-212 with near-term clinic timelines.
Posted investor presentation on Sept 8, 2026; furnished as Exhibit 99.1 under Regulation FD disclosure.
Prula-cel advancing toward registrational pathway for LN/SLE; pivotal start-up activities and interim pivotal data anticipated in coming years.
ADI-212 IND cleared for mCRPC; company plans to initiate clinical enrollment in 4Q 2026 with data expected 1H/2H 2027.
Prula-cel initial clinical data (cut-off Aug 31, 2025) from seven patients showed clinical activity, favorable safety and immune reset signals.
In vivo CAR-T and other programs targeted for clinical data starts in 2027–2028; timelines subject to enrollment, regulatory feedback and financing.
